centering: Original reserved source centre through native TPS; no relocation, resampling or padding
coverage: Local WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant plane, densified window boundary; minimum boundary clearance gates complete coverage, area fraction descriptive only
original: 300 m + 1 m/s maximum absolute source separation across native first/last rows
nearest_rounding: Literal coordinate half-step cell plus original radius and 30 seconds
symmetric_one_step: Literal coordinate one-step cell plus original radius and 60 seconds
incomplete_coverage: Prepare and inspect the unchanged window; abstain from source-supported class assignment when any scenario is incomplete
positive_labels: No automated source class assignment. Image observations remain provisional and ignored, irrespective of source proximity
first_pass: Both HH/HV and all four quadrants before source overlays, distance reconciliation or any model scores
annotator: Codex AI assistant; no independent SAR reviewer
